title: Via Welcomes the Knode.ai Team to Accelerate AI for Public Transit
summary: Via has welcomed the Knode.ai team to enhance AI capabilities for public transit, aiming to optimize operations across cities and transit agencies.
body_markdown:
We are delighted to announce that the Knode.ai team has joined Via to accelerate the development of agentic AI for transit operations.


Knode.ai built an agentic AI platform that helps organizations analyze frontline performance, automate operational workflows, and turn complex data into action. At Via, the team will apply that expertise across product, engineering, and AI initiatives serving the hundreds of cities, transit agencies, school districts, and universities that rely on Via's platform.


"We’re excited to welcome the


[Knode.ai](http://knode.ai/) team to Via," said Lior Gerenstein, Chief Technology Officer of Via. "This team brings deep expertise in applying AI to complex operational environments, and we're thrilled to have them on board."


"Via has built the category-defining platform for public transit," said Riccardo Pellegrini, co-founder and CEO of Knode.ai. "It's the ideal place to leverage agentic AI in one of the most important operational environments in the world."
